description: Juan Reyes Sierra, a UCF senior, shares his father’s account of September 11, 2001, noting that he was not yet born when the attacks occurred. At the time, his father managed the Colony Beach and Resort in Longboat Key, Florida, and was responsible for logistics during President George W. Bush’s visit there on the morning of September 11. Reyes Sierra says his father recalled preparing a brunch menu for the visit and having his photograph taken with the president. His father later observed that Sarasota Airport had shut down and that fighter jets were present, amid concern that the president might be targeted. The account is inherited family memory rather than Reyes Sierra’s personal experience of 9/11; he describes feeling proud to share his father’s story. In the recording, Reyes Sierra holds up a phone displaying a photograph of two people in shirts and ties; the people shown are not identified by the visual evidence.
